name: Kibookal Warli Tribal Mural
composition: A terracotta / mud-brown ground covered with white Warli motifs: triangle-bodied stick figures, the tarpa-dance spiral, trees, huts, animals and the central circle, arranged in rhythmic repeating bands; minimal, monochrome white-on-earth.

Minimal, monochrome white-on-earth, hand-painted village-wall texture, symbolic and joyful.
